errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assigns colors to the models. In the chart, 'TDNN-HMM' is orange (described as red), 'LSTM-HMM' is gray (described as yellow), and 'End-to-End' is yellow (described as orange).

The description states the value for the 'End-to-End' bar in 'Test1' is approximately 29%. However, the chart shows this value is approximately 12.5%. The value of 29% is closer to the 'TDNN-HMM' bar, which is approximately 30.5%.
